effortlessbuilding.modedescription.norma: Disable mod and use vanilla placement rules
Like vanilla, but with increased reach
effortlessbuilding.modedescription.dome: Build a domed roof. Click center, set radius, then height.
effortlessbuilding.action.open_server_co: Change reach, placement limits and what blocks you can break here.
effortlessbuilding.action.preview_lock.d: Anchor the current preview in the world. Walk around to check it, right-click to build it, left-click or lock again to release it.
effortlessbuilding.message.preview_locke: §aPreview anchored » Right-click to build, arrow keys / Page Up/Down to move it
effortlessbuilding.action.replace_only_a: You can only place blocks where there was air. Replaceables such as short grass and ferns can still be replaced.
effortlessbuilding.action.replace_blocks: You can replace blocks and air.
effortlessbuilding.action.replace_only_b: You can only replace blocks, not air.
effortlessbuilding.action.replace_filter: You can only replace blocks that match the block in your offhand.
effortlessbuilding.action.toggle_protect: If enabled, blocks that hold data such as chests, furnaces, and hoppers can not be replaced.
effortlessbuilding.message.only_break_pl: You can only break blocks that you placed this session
effortlessbuilding.message.only_replace_: You can only replace blocks that you placed this session
effortlessbuilding.message.breaking_disa: Breaking blocks with build modes is disabled in survival
effortlessbuilding.message.too_hard: Some blocks exceeded the maximum hardness
effortlessbuilding.message.world_border: Some blocks are outside the world border or build height
effortlessbuilding.message.not_operator: Only admins can edit functional settings.
effortlessbuilding.message.welcome_messa: Thank you for using Effortless Building! To get started, hold %s to open the build menu.
effortlessbuilding.message.build_mode_hi: You have activated a build mode! With a block in hand, right-click to pick the starting position. Aim somewhere else, then right-click again to build the shape. To deactivate, hold %s and select Disable.
effortlessbuilding.config.reach.tooltip: How far away you can place and break blocks with build modes.
effortlessbuilding.config.max_blocks_pla: Maximum number of blocks placed in a single action.
effortlessbuilding.config.max_blocks_per: Maximum size of a build mode shape along any axis.
effortlessbuilding.config.max_mirror_siz: Maximum diameter for mirror and radial mirror modifiers.
effortlessbuilding.config.max_array_coun: Maximum number of copies an array modifier can produce.
effortlessbuilding.config.max_array_offs: Maximum offset distance for each array modifier axis.
effortlessbuilding.config.allow_breaking: If on, build modes can be used to break blocks.
effortlessbuilding.config.only_placed_bl: If on, you can only break blocks that were placed this session.
effortlessbuilding.config.max_hardness.t:
Maximum block hardness that can be broken. -1 = no limit.

Examples:
  0.5 = Dirt, Sand
  1.5 = Stone
  2.0 = Wood Planks, Logs
  4.5 = Ores
  50 = Obsidian
If on, you must have the correct tools in your inventory to break blocks.
effortlessbuilding.config.use_durability: If on, breaking blocks will consume durability from the appropriate tool in your inventory.
effortlessbuilding.config.show_welcome_m: If on, each player receives the welcome message once per world.
effortlessbuilding.config.show_build_mod: If on, each player receives the build-mode usage hint once per world.
effortlessbuilding.config.preview_block_: Size of block previews as a percentage of a full block.
Transparency of block previews. 0% = invisible, 100% = solid.
effortlessbuilding.config.max_block_prev:
Maximum number of block models rendered in the preview.
Lower values improve performance with large shapes.
Outlines are always drawn for all blocks.
effortlessbuilding.config.protect_tile_e: If on, blocks that hold data such as chests, furnaces, and hoppers cannot be replaced or broken.
effortlessbuilding.modedescription.shape: Build the shape from the Shape Generator. Click to place it, or click the center and then the edge to size it.
effortlessbuilding.action.open_shape_gen: Design gears, rings, arches, stars and more, or load a schematic.
effortlessbuilding.action.shape_size_scr: One click places the shape at the size set in the Shape Generator.
effortlessbuilding.action.shape_size_cli: Click the center, then click at the edge. The design scales to that radius.
effortlessbuilding.message.no_shape_temp: No shape templates yet. Save one in the Shape Generator.
effortlessbuilding.screen.use_shape.desc: Switch to Shape mode with this shape.
effortlessbuilding.screen.schematic.desc: Put .schem files (WorldEdit) or .nbt files (structure blocks) in config/effortlessbuilding/schematics, schematics, or config/worldedit/schematics. Your held block is placed wherever the file has a block. In multiplayer the server needs the file too.
effortlessbuilding.screen.editing.descri: Click to switch between the main shape and its parts. Parts combine with everything before them, in order.
effortlessbuilding.screen.add_part: Add another shape. It joins on; change its Operation to cut, intersect or exclude instead.
effortlessbuilding.screen.view.descripti: 3D, or a slice through the top, front or side
effortlessbuilding.screen.drag_to_rotate: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom
effortlessbuilding.action.open_palette.d: Build with several blocks at once: from hotbar slots or picked by color. Lit up when on.
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_button: Build with several blocks mixed in a pattern. The 3D preview shows the colors.
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_enable: Use palette for every build mode
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_source: Hotbar: the blocks in the slots you pick, whatever they hold at build time. Picked: a fixed list chosen here.
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_custom: Click blocks on the right to add
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_patter: How the blocks are laid out over the build.
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_previe: 3D preview: drag to rotate, scroll to zoom
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_empty: No blocks: pick hotbar slots holding blocks
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_off_hi: Palette is off: builds use your held block
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_rescan: Read every block's color again, e.g. after changing resource packs.
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_all_bl: All blocks by color (click to add)
effortlessbuilding.screen.suggest.shades: Dark to light blocks in the same color family as the first block.
effortlessbuilding.screen.suggest.simila: The blocks closest in color to the first block.
Even steps from the first block to the last one.
effortlessbuilding.screen.suggest.analog: The first block plus blocks of nearby hues on the color wheel.
effortlessbuilding.screen.suggest.hint: Suggestions start from your palette's first block (or the held block)
effortlessbuilding.screen.suggest.need_s: Add a block or hold one first
effortlessbuilding.screen.suggest.neighb: The first block plus blocks of nearby hues on the color wheel.
effortlessbuilding.screen.suggest.comple: The first block's color and its opposite on the color wheel, in lighter and darker versions.
Three colors evenly spaced around the color wheel, starting from the first block.
effortlessbuilding.screen.suggest.contra: The first block's hue from near-black to near-white.
effortlessbuilding.screen.suggest.surpri: A random colorful block with a random strategy. Reroll for another.
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_reroll: Run the last suggestion again with different picks among the closest matches.
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_save_f: Keep this palette in Favorites. A hotbar palette is saved as the blocks it holds now.
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_reload: Read the preset files again. Add your own .json palettes to config/effortlessbuilding/palettes.
effortlessbuilding.screen.palette_no_fav: No favorites yet. Use "Save as favorite" on the left.
effortlessbuilding.shape.param.center_bl: Adds a center axle through the shape in a block you pick, even where the shape is open. It is 1 block wide, or 2 by 2 when the shape has an even width and no single middle.
effortlessbuilding.screen.picker_hint: Click a block to pick it. Scroll to browse; hold Alt to scroll faster.
effortlessbuilding.message.out_of_super_: Out of Super Glue: part of the shape was not glued
effortlessbuilding.screen.materials.desc: What this build needs, what you carry, what your AE2 network holds, and what is missing.
effortlessbuilding.screen.export_schem.d: Save exactly what would be built as a WorldEdit/Litematica .schem in config/effortlessbuilding/schematics (named after the template name box).
effortlessbuilding.screen.export_nbt.des: Save exactly what would be built as a structure .nbt (structure blocks, Create's schematicannon) in config/effortlessbuilding/schematics.
effortlessbuilding.message.export_hold_b: Hold a block (or turn on a palette) to export this shape
effortlessbuilding.screen.pixel_art.desc: Turn a PNG into a schematic made of the blocks whose colors match best.
effortlessbuilding.screen.pixel_art_file: Click to pick the next PNG in the images folder.
effortlessbuilding.screen.pixel_art_hint: Put .png files in %s. Transparent pixels stay empty.
effortlessbuilding.screen.pixel_art_no_b: No blocks to use: carry some blocks, or wait for the color scan
effortlessbuilding.screen.pixel_art_crea: Save it as <image>_art.schem and select it as the shape to build.
effortlessbuilding.screen.path_sizing_hi: Click the start, then the end of the path
effortlessbuilding.action.open_anchor_vi: See the whole anchored preview with the terrain around it, move it, build it or release it.
effortlessbuilding.screen.anchor_move.de: Move the anchored preview one block (five with Shift).
effortlessbuilding.screen.anchor_terrain: Too big to show the terrain as well
effortlessbuilding.screen.anchor_none: Nothing is anchored. Lock a preview first (the anchor button in the radial menu).
effortlessbuilding.config.blocks_per_tic: Big builds are placed this many blocks per server tick, over several ticks, so the server does not freeze. 0 places everything at once.
effortlessbuilding.screen.copy_code.desc: Copy this design (parts and settings included) as a text code you can paste in chat or Discord.
effortlessbuilding.screen.copy_palette_c: Copy this palette as a text code you can paste in chat or Discord.
effortlessbuilding.screen.paste_code.des: Load a code someone shared (copy it first).
effortlessbuilding.message.code_invalid: The clipboard has no code for this
effortlessbuilding.shape.param.bearing.d: Puts a Create mechanical bearing at one end of the center axle, facing the shape and left out of the glue, so the shape can turn. Start = below / north / west, End = above / south / east. Fills the axle if the middle is open.
effortlessbuilding.action.open_undo_hist: See your recent builds and undo or redo several at once.
effortlessbuilding.screen.undo_history.h: Click a build to undo it and everything after it. Grey ones are undone: click to redo.
effortlessbuilding.screen.undo_history.e: Nothing to undo or redo yet
effortlessbuilding.shape.param.smooth.de: Top blocks one step above their neighbor become stairs (slabs at corners) or slabs of the same block, so slopes look smooth. Blocks with no stairs or slab version stay full. In survival you need the stairs and slabs.
effortlessbuilding.message.schematic_too: Schematic %s is too big to send to this server; put it in the server's schematics folder instead
effortlessbuilding.shape.param.align.des: Where the parts stand when their heights differ: from the bottom up, grown both ways from the middle, or hanging from the top. The start values move each part further.
effortlessbuilding.shape.param.follow_gr: Off: the shape stays level. On: every column moves up or down to sit on the terrain below it.
effortlessbuilding.shape.param.super_glu: Glue the built shape with Create super glue, only around its own blocks. In survival it uses your Super Glue's durability.
effortlessbuilding.screen.part_block.des: The block this part is built with. None: the held block or palette, like the main shape.
effortlessbuilding.screen.part_repeat.de: Copies of this part spread evenly around the main shape (spokes, pillars, towers on a wall). Move the part off-center with the offsets first.
